category_title: Students with visual impairments and no speech who use non-visual communication methods
student_description: Jane is a student with a visual impairment and no speech who communicates via sounds, facial expressions, and a verbal communication book (yes/no/none of the above). She cannot engage with standard visual materials like iPads or photos, requiring tutors to use verbal choices, physical props, or perceivable sensory changes like lighting.

criteria.criterion_name: Consistent Integration of the Verbal Communication Book
criteria.rationale: Jane's primary expressive communication relies on her verbal communication book due to her lack of speech and inability to see small icons.
criteria.check: The long-term plan must explicitly structure ongoing activities around yes/no/none-of-the-above questioning formats to ensure she can consistently use her verbal communication book to participate.
